Monica, thanks for the clear recap. A couple of constraints from our procurement team that are blockers unless we can get an exception:

- Our org policy requires prepayment for all SaaS pilots where we cannot issue a standing PO. Unfortunately we currently cannot issue POs for external vendors under our new vendor-onboarding model. That means we need to prepay for the pilot term via corporate card or wire.
- There is a 75k annualized review threshold as you noted. Procurement needs to see the forecasted spend and commit to a billing route to complete risk review.
- We are actively evaluating marketplace billing on our cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace). If Redwood is available there and supports consolidated billing, procurement prefers that route.

Can you confirm if Redwood supports: (A) an upfront prepay invoice, (B) card-on-file billing for the pilot, or (C) marketplace listing and transactable SKU for a short-term pilot?

If neither A nor B is possible, procurement has indicated they will escalate but it will add 2-4 weeks to the timeline.
